hints.title: Symmetric Pairing Insight
hints.text: A palindrome can incorporate pairs of identical letters symmetrically on both sides, with at most one odd letter positioned at the exact center.

hints.title: Even Count Addition Rule
hints.text: For each unique character, the largest even number of occurrences contributes directly to the outer palindrome wings, leaving at most one leftover character for the middle.

hints.title: Paired Character Summation Procedure
hints.text: Count the occurrences of every character. For each count, add the count rounded down to the nearest multiple of two to the total length. If any character had an odd count, add one to the final total for the center character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations takes factorial O(N!) time and quickly exhausts memory on strings longer than 10 characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting character frequencies in a fixed alphabet table takes O(N) time and O(1) space (at most 128 ASCII symbols).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should clearly explain why even counts always pair up and why at most one central odd element can be accommodated.
